'''Campfire banana boat''' is a very easy and popular camping dessert. It requires no dishes—you eat it straight from the peel! 

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]] 
*Mini [[cookbook:marshmallow|marshmallow]]s 
*[[cookbook:Chocolate Chips|Chocolate chips]] 

==Procedure==
#Peel back a 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (4 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) wide strip of peel from the inside curve of the banana, leaving one end attached to the banana. 
#Cut out and remove a wedge-shaped cavity from the length of the banana. 
#Fill cavity with mini-marshmallows and chocolate chips 
#Replace peel and wrap well in heavy duty [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]]. 
#Place on coals for about 5 minutes. 
#Open carefully and eat with a spoon right from the banana peel.
